verdict.rationale: Sentry's Seer Autofix finds root causes and generates suggested code fixes for errors. First-party coding-agent integrations send Seer's root cause analysis to Cursor Cloud Agents or GitHub Copilot, which generate the fix and create pull requests for review. Seer itself requires a paid subscription. missing for 10: evidence that Seer opens PRs natively rather than through third-party coding agents, details of the PR review workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
